build_steps.description: Install system packages: git, curl, wget, ca-certificates, gnupg, xmlstarlet, maven
Copy setup_runtime.sh and repo_setup.sh from build context to /opt/benchmark/
Execute repo_setup.sh to materialize /workspace from git repository
Execute setup_runtime.sh to install Java 8 (Temurin JDK 8u412) and pre-cache Maven dependencies
Set environment variables JAVA_HOME, MAVEN_HOME, and PATH

repo_materialization.method: git shallow clone with partial blob filter

output_image.ready_for: RL agent execution with pre-cached dependencies
